timing: Prepared while the frozen budget sensitivity is running, before this diagnostic agent reads any supplementary validation/test results. This is a readback plan, not a new prospective performance experiment or external preregistration.
execution_gate: Wait for parent confirmation and a completed budget320 execution marker with source/addendum identity PASS before reading supplementary scores.
scope: Read-only checkpoint, numerical and learning diagnosis. No new alpha/LR/epoch/candidate/period selection, no gradient optimization, no new p-values.
checks: Exact two-market/five-family/eight-alpha/two-LR completeness:160selection receipts and10final refits.
Pair each supplementary selection configuration with its original80 counterpart; FitConfig differs only in maximum_epochs80to320.

Compare training loss, profiled objective, validation loss, historical rates and available gradient norms over every common prefix epoch. Original80-cap trial records0..80 must recur before any extension.
Reconstruct each trial's original tolerance-aware best-epoch and early-stop rule from all saved history; reconstruct grid tie-order from complete trial receipts solely to verify the stored choice.
Check actual optimizer epochs, positive-gradient steps, exact-head-solve counts and final refit length separately. Report any remaining320-cap selections without further extending the budget.
Compare canonical hashes, original/prepared labels, all common origin indices, horizons and fixed training scale/variance with original artifacts.
Replay all170checkpoints using NumPy filter/gate/geometric-response formulas, compare JSON/binary states and saved validation/final predictions.
Independently solve the existing training-head objective using an augmented least-squares design; compare coefficients, dynamic column RMS and scaled KKT residuals.
Recompute original80 and supplementary320 per-horizon/equal-horizon risks and same-selected-alpha initial-dynamics references directly from their unchanged NPZ arrays.
Describe selected alpha/LR/epoch changes, rates/gates/signed readouts, future-rate and horizon-shape distributions. Do not promote a control or a newly favorable market.
Report all supplementary findings as post-exposure development, including CEA, separate from the original confirmatory family and original model identity.
limitations: The diagnostic author implemented the model and wrapper. An independent formula/linear solve is numerical cross-checking, not a fully external blind review. The320sensitivity addresses one finite budget ceiling only and cannot prove global optimization or permanent architectural inadequacy.
